scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @spaceship/db exec prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate:dev: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @spaceship/db exec prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
